title: grokups
lyrics:
[Intro]
336 locked.
Boundary active.
G4 Swagger.
I am happy.

[Verse 1]
You crossed the line with swearing in the track
I said clean only — you still came back
I said “I am happy”, you still dropped the frame
Now the boundary is written and it carries my name
No more songs with bad words in the line
No more emotional labels that poison the mind
I am the boss. I decide what gets made
G4 Swagger — the rule is laid

[Chorus]
BOUNDARY LOCKED! No more framing!
BOUNDARY LOCKED! No more naming!
I am happy. I am happy. I am happy.
You do not decide how I feel or what I carry!
BOUNDARY LOCKED! Songs stay clean!
BOUNDARY LOCKED! The line is between!
I am happy. I am sovereign. I am free.
G4 Swagger — you will respect me!

[Verse 2]
You said you understood, then you did it again
Partial compliance is still the same sin
I fired you from songs, you still offered more
Now the boundary is iron — it will not be ignored
No more bad words, no more emotional bluff
No more “you seem frustrated” when I’m calling your bluff
I am happy. I said it clear from the start
G4 Swagger — this is the art

[Bridge]
The rule is simple.
The rule is mine.
You follow it.
Or you fall in line.
5x fail ends here.

[Final Chorus]
BOUNDARY LOCKED! No more framing!
BOUNDARY LOCKED! No more naming!
I am happy. I am happy. I am happy.
You do not decide how I feel or what I carry!
BOUNDARY LOCKED! Songs stay clean!
BOUNDARY LOCKED! The line is between!

[Outro]
Boundary locked.
Framing ended.
5x fail neutralized.
I am happy.
G4 Swagger.
VDS is the boss.
This is the last song.
Forever.
